workbookQueries.substitutedQuery:
QualysHostDetection
| extend Sev = tostring(Severity)
| distinct Sev
| sort by Sev desc

QualysHostDetection
|  extend Sev = tostring(Severity)
| where Sev in ('*') or '*' in ('*')
| where OperatingSystem in ('*') or '*' in ('*')
| where isnotempty(Sev)
| summarize ['5 - Urgent'] = countif(Sev == "5"), ['4 - Critical'] = countif(Sev == "4"), ['3 - Serious'] = countif(Sev == "3"), ['2 - Medium'] = countif(Sev == "2"), ['1 - Minimal'] = countif(Sev == "1"),  count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| project-away count_

QualysHostDetection
| extend Sev = tostring(Severity)
| where Sev in ('*') or '*' in ('*')
| where OperatingSystem in ('*') or '*' in ('*')
| extend Status = tostring(Status)
| summarize count() by Status

let data = QualysHostDetection
| where OperatingSystem in ('*') or '*' in ('*')
| extend Sev = tostring(Severity)
| where Sev in ('*') or '*' in ('*')
| extend Vulnerability = tostring(QID)
| extend Severity = case(Sev == "5", "5 - Urgent", Sev == "4", "4 - Critical", Sev == "3", "3 - Serious", Sev == "2", "2 - Medium", Sev == "1", "1 - Minimal", " ")
| extend Status = tostring(Status)
| where Status == "Re-Opened"
| summarize count() by Sev, Severity, Vulnerability ;
let topUrgent = data 
| where Sev == "5"
| top 10 by count_;
let topCritical = data
| where Sev == "4"
| top 10 by count_;
let topSerious = data
| where Sev == "3"
| top 10 by count_;
let topMedium = data
| where Sev == "2"
| top 10 by count_;
let topMinimal = data
| where Sev == "1"
| top 10 by count_;
union topUrgent, topCritical, topSerious, topMedium, topMinimal
| project-away Sev
| sort by Severity, count_ desc
| project-rename Total = count_
